knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic claims snapshot
knowledge.detail: Five fictional claims with suppliers, purchase orders, affected lines, evidence references, and status.

knowledge.name: Supplier service terms
knowledge.detail: Severity, response window, and resolution window for damage, shortage, quality, and pricing claims.

knowledge.name: Evidence requirements
knowledge.detail: Required photos and documents for each claim type used to judge pack completeness.

intelligence_processing.name: Claim triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Assigns severity, responsible supplier, and response and resolution windows by claim type.

intelligence_processing.name: Evidence completeness check
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares required evidence with what is on file and totals the claim value by line.

intelligence_processing.name: Deadline computation
intelligence_processing.detail: Computes elapsed and remaining hours and business-day due dates from a fixed demo clock.

intelligence_processing.name: Supplier offer evaluation
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares credit offered with the claim value and returns the unrecovered gap.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the Draft agent with seven skills and two synthetic knowledge files; publishing is gated.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Teams access
clients_user_interface.detail: Claims-team entry point once approved controls are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file SupplierClaimEngagementAgent locally with deterministic routing.

management_reporting.name: Claims queue view
management_reporting.detail: Open claims, open value, severity, status, and recovery to date.

management_reporting.name: Deadline tracker
management_reporting.detail: Breached, at-risk, and on-track claims against supplier response windows.

management_reporting.name: Acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Seven locked persona cases, transcripts, and the separate publish approval gate.

tools.name: Portable SupplierClaimEngagementAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with seven deterministic read-only operations over synthetic data.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the seven-skill package in Draft; publishing needs explicit approval.

tools.name: Power Automate agent flow
tools.detail: Materialized flow that returns the agent's exact outputs for each operation.

tools.name: Microsoft Outlook
tools.detail: Cited send channel for approved supplier notices; the package sends nothing.

tools.name: Authorized coordinator workflow
tools.detail: Cited human workflow for sends, credit acceptance, and escalations.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional claims and forbids browsing, live-system claims, or invented values.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never sends, accepts, rejects, escalates, or changes a case.

supporting_features.name: Coordinator decision gate
supporting_features.detail: Every supplier send, credit decision, and escalation stays with an authorized coordinator.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic routing and validation
supporting_features.detail: Seven natural-language cases verify one operation each with exact evidence anchors.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: The Copilot Studio package stays Draft until an authorized publish decision.
